title: Liver, Fed-1, miRNA-seq
characteristics_ch1: tissue: Liver | Sex: male | strain: C57BL/6J | genotype: Wild-type | treatment: Fed ad libitum
treatment_protocol_ch1: 10-week-old male C57BL/6J mice were purchased from the Shanghai Laboratory Animal Company (SLAC, Shanghai, China). Mice were fed ad libitum or fasted for 24 hour. Then, mice were sacrificed and livers were harvested for RNA extraction.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was harvested using Trizol reagent and used for removing the rRNAs using Ribo-Zero rRNA Removal Kits (Illumina, San Diego, CA, USA) following the manufacturer's instructions. | RNA libraries were constructed by using rRNA-depleted RNAs with TruSeq Stranded Total RNA Library Prep Kit (Illumina, San Diego, CA,  USA) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Libraries were controlled for quality and quantified using  the BioAnalyzer 2100 system (Agilent Technologies, Inc., USA).
data_processing: hisat2 for sequence alignment | stringtie tools for transcript assembly, transcript abundance estimation, gene structure optimization | samtools tools for related file processing | Assembly: mm10 | Supplementary files format and content: Excel format representing TPM and count values of miRNAs
